fix: Read the number with extract_number_before(text, 'damage to 1 of') as a second try (before the 30 default). Check every card named Skill Dive for its own number (ex3 version may really be 30).

problem: Pinsir (ex12-24) text has no coin flip: 'Does 20 damage to 1 of your Benched Pokémon' (30 to the Defending Pokémon, then 20 to one of your own Benched). The shared executor flips a coin and only damages the Bench on TAILS, so on heads (50%) the self-damage never happens (probe message: 'HEADS! NO BENCH DAMAGE!').
evidence: Attack_Effects.gd:6792-6800 (execute_overhead_toss: flip_coin, 'if not coin'), dispatch Attack_Effects.gd:29400-29406 (ex12- branch calls the same executor).
fix: Give execute_overhead_toss a parameter (e.g. needs_flip=true) and pass false from the ex12- branch; keep the coin for the base-set card.
